Class PoolChatServer.StdoutWork

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.pool.PoolChatServer.StdoutWork
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Enclosing class:
PoolChatServer
private static final class PoolChatServer.StdoutWork extends Object implements Runnable
The StdoutWork class reads one generation of child stdout. End of stream, a read error, or a zero byte and an over-long line are reported back to the server.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      The run method reads stdout until the generation ends. A null process marks the child dead and returns. End of stream and a read error do the same. A generation change returns. A zero byte fails with detail NUL. A line over 1 MiB fails with detail line over 1 MiB. Any other line is dispatched.
